authority.phase1_preservation_rule: Capability identity, contract clauses, provenance, accepted DROP evidence, and explicit non-capability records are preserved; composition does not silently delete or merge clauses.
authority.current_upstream_rule: Targeted current-upstream evidence informs seams and ownership; discovered drift is recorded, not silently compensated.
authority.final_gate: No REVIEW_BLOCKED or unresolved composition blocker is accepted in the final plan.

relationship_types.EXTENDS: optional enhancement with safe base degradation
relationship_types.ORDER_AFTER: reconstruction ordering only, not runtime dependency

feature_lines.name: Session metadata search core
feature_lines.purpose: Provide a valid, settled, Unicode-tokenized metadata-search substrate with durable schema/index lifecycle behavior.
feature_lines.upstream_seam: hermes_state.py + hermes_state_search.py + hermes_state_schema.py at current upstream main; current upstream has session storage/search primitives but not the fork's settled six-index lifecycle.
acceptance: A fresh temporary HERMES_HOME can create, settle, rebuild, and query the core metadata indexes.
Unicode-tokenized metadata queries preserve visibility, archive/pin/source filters, ranking, limits, and safe fallback behavior.
Schema refusal/recovery states are explicit and restart-safe.
feature_lines.landing_state: Metadata search is usable with the Unicode core only; optional CJK/trigram and routing lines are absent and must degrade to existing fallback behavior.
evidence_gaps: Refresh exact schema/index seam immediately before Phase 2 implementation.
feature_lines.rationale: Storage-v2 and lifecycle settlement have no coherent accepted state when separated: an index variant without durable settlement is not a usable substrate. Unicode is the baseline tokenizer contract for the core.

feature_lines.name: CJK metadata search extension
feature_lines.purpose: Add CJK-aware metadata search without making non-CJK installations depend on the optional tokenizer/index.
feature_lines.upstream_seam: hermes_state_search.py CJK route and CJK FTS schema at current upstream main.
acceptance: CJK queries select the CJK route when the index is available.
Missing/unhealthy CJK support degrades to the documented fallback without breaking Unicode metadata search.
feature_lines.landing_state: Core metadata search remains valid when this extension is not installed or its index is unavailable.
evidence_gaps: Confirm native/CJK build availability on supported deployment targets.
feature_lines.rationale: CJK is independently optional and has a safe fallback; it must not block the core line.

feature_lines.name: Trigram metadata search extension
feature_lines.purpose: Add infix/trigram metadata search as an optional index variant with bounded fallback semantics.
feature_lines.upstream_seam: hermes_state_search.py trigram route/schema and rebuild state at current upstream main.
acceptance: Infix queries route to trigram candidates when available.
Trigram rebuild failure or absence leaves the core route and bounded LIKE fallback correct.
feature_lines.landing_state: Core metadata search remains valid without trigram indexing.
evidence_gaps: Recheck trigram index rebuild high-water behavior against current upstream schema.
feature_lines.rationale: Trigram is an independently deployable search enhancement, not a prerequisite for metadata search correctness.

feature_lines.name: Session metadata search routing
feature_lines.purpose: Select the appropriate metadata-search route and preserve ranking, visibility, lineage, and fallback invariants across available variants.
feature_lines.upstream_seam: hermes_state.py/hermes_state_search.py metadata candidate router and picker/API callers at current upstream main.
acceptance: Token, Unicode, CJK, trigram, and infix queries select the intended route when its prerequisite is healthy.
Only empty successful FTS routes fall back; stale responses, visibility filters, lineage, and limits remain correct.
feature_lines.landing_state: Routing is accepted against the core route; optional index variants remain absent or are treated as unavailable.
evidence_gaps: Current upstream has a different search seam; perform a targeted API/caller comparison before implementation.
feature_lines.rationale: Routing consumes the core substrate but is a separate acceptance boundary because it coordinates multiple optional variants and public picker/API behavior.

feature_lines.name: Literal-safe session title resolution
feature_lines.purpose: Keep numbered-title resolution literal-safe and strict without coupling it to FTS index availability.
feature_lines.upstream_seam: hermes_state.py title resolution/LIKE escaping at current upstream main.
acceptance: LIKE metacharacters remain literal and only strict ASCII #N suffixes form numbered variants.
Title resolution works with or without optional FTS extensions.
feature_lines.landing_state: Title safety is accepted independently; metadata routing can use the shared session store without importing this line's grammar.
evidence_gaps: Validate current upstream callers that may depend on broader historical #% behavior.
feature_lines.rationale: The contract is search-adjacent but independently testable and does not require FTS routing.

feature_lines.name: Compression-aware session lineage search
feature_lines.purpose: Preserve lineage, reset boundaries, visibility, and resume semantics across compressed session segments.
feature_lines.upstream_seam: hermes_state.py lineage/session resume methods and agent/conversation_compression.py boundary integration at current upstream main.
acceptance: Compressed parents, children, resets, and branch markers resolve to the correct visible lineage tip.
Archived/compacted history remains discoverable without reintroducing reset or delegate branches.
feature_lines.landing_state: Lineage behavior is valid without metadata FTS routing or context preview extensions.
evidence_gaps: Separate upstream-owned lineage behavior from fork residual clauses before Phase 2.
feature_lines.rationale: Lineage is a session-state contract, not a metadata-index dependency. It shares session storage with search but has its own acceptance seam.

feature_lines.name: Session search context hydration
feature_lines.purpose: Return bounded surrounding message context with explicit lock scope and safe decode fallback.
feature_lines.upstream_seam: hermes_state.py message-search result projection at current upstream main; current upstream has per-match hydration but not the fork's batch/lock policy.
acceptance: Every match receives only its preceding/matching/following context window.
Batch hydration is bounded and indexing/decoding outside the lock does not change result semantics.
A decode/query failure degrades the affected context to empty without losing the match.
feature_lines.landing_state: Search results remain valid with empty context previews; no metadata FTS or lineage feature is required at runtime by this line.
evidence_gaps: Confirm the current upstream search projection seam and retained batch size.
feature_lines.rationale: This is a distinct observable query/lock behavior; file overlap and the phrase session search do not establish a hard dependency on metadata routing or lineage.

feature_lines.name: Headroom compression substrate
feature_lines.purpose: Compress oversized context/tool payloads with bounded, metadata-safe output and explicit degradation.
feature_lines.upstream_seam: plugins/headroom and context/plugin registration seam at current upstream main; no equivalent upstream implementation was found in Phase 1.
acceptance: Configured thresholds activate compression without expanding tool metadata.
Compression failures preserve usable content and emit the required warning contract.
Plugin registration/schema remains valid when active.
feature_lines.landing_state: Compression works without retrieval; compressed output remains usable even when no retrieval tool is available.
feature_lines.rationale: Compression is the independently useful base substrate; retrieval is an extension with a stricter dependency.

feature_lines.name: Headroom compressed-context retrieval
feature_lines.purpose: Expose bounded retrieval of compressed context only when compression has produced retrievable context.
feature_lines.upstream_seam: plugins/headroom retrieval tool registration and auto-enable path at current upstream main.
acceptance: Retrieval schema is stable and bounded.
The tool is enabled only with active compression and fails explicitly if registration/context is unavailable.
feature_lines.landing_state: Compression remains correct and useful with retrieval disabled or unavailable.
evidence_gaps: Decide whether retrieval remains plugin-owned or maps to a future generic context API.
feature_lines.rationale: Retrieval has no meaningful source context without compression, but compression has a complete acceptance state without retrieval.

feature_lines.name: Memory trim policy
feature_lines.purpose: Avoid low-value and expensive heap work while preserving cheap malloc_trim cadence.
feature_lines.upstream_seam: hermes_cli/mem_trim.py and housekeeping configuration at current upstream main.
acceptance: RSS below threshold skips expensive work.
GC obeys its independent cooldown while malloc_trim remains eligible.
Invalid/force configuration behavior remains safe.
feature_lines.landing_state: Memory recovery policy is valid with diagnostics absent or best-effort disabled.
evidence_gaps: Confirm current upstream housekeeping caller/config naming.
feature_lines.rationale: Policy changes runtime scheduling and has an independent operational acceptance seam.

feature_lines.name: Memory trim diagnostics
feature_lines.purpose: Attribute trim cost and pressure without becoming a prerequisite for recovery.
feature_lines.upstream_seam: hermes_cli/mem_trim.py diagnostic collection at current upstream main; upstream has basic RSS logging but not fork attribution fields.
acceptance: GC/trim timing, fragmentation, and VmSwap are best-effort diagnostics.
Diagnostic failure never blocks the policy line's recovery behavior.
feature_lines.landing_state: Policy remains correct when malloc_info/VmSwap diagnostics are unavailable.
evidence_gaps: Confirm Linux/glibc-only fields and long-term stable event schema.
feature_lines.rationale: Diagnostics are optional and share mem_trim.py with policy, but their failure must not invalidate policy acceptance.

feature_lines.name: Compression session-boundary semantics
feature_lines.purpose: Prevent compressor-reported no-op output from creating a false session rotation/rewrite.
feature_lines.upstream_seam: agent/conversation_compression.py no-progress/session rotation path at current upstream main.
acceptance: A compressor status noop does not rotate or rewrite the session, including newly allocated equal output.
Locks and cached prompt state are released/preserved safely on the no-op path.
feature_lines.landing_state: Compression boundary semantics are valid without lineage search; lineage remains a separate session-state line.
evidence_gaps: Confirm the canonical third-party compressor status field.
feature_lines.rationale: Both compression and lineage mention boundaries, but this line owns the local compression transition and does not require lineage search implementation.

feature_lines.name: Runtime lifecycle observability
feature_lines.purpose: Emit structured lifecycle, tool, stream, SQLite, and delivery telemetry at diagnosable execution boundaries.
feature_lines.upstream_seam: lifecycle_telemetry.py, sqlite_native_telemetry.py, turn_context.py, and gateway event seams; no matching current-upstream module was found by targeted search.
acceptance: Stable event contracts are emitted at selected lifecycle boundaries.
Telemetry failures cannot change the underlying lifecycle or SQLite result.
Sensitive payloads remain excluded/redacted by contract.
feature_lines.landing_state: All runtime capabilities remain correct with telemetry disabled; the line can be accepted through event contract tests alone.
evidence_gaps: Finalize the stable event subset and sink/redaction contract before Phase 2.
feature_lines.rationale: Phase 1 NEEDS_REVIEW is resolved here as an independently testable optional line rather than silently attached to every runtime feature.

feature_lines.name: SQLite write contention policy
feature_lines.purpose: Bound SQLite write contention with rollback-safe exponential retry behavior.
feature_lines.upstream_seam: hermes_state.py _execute_write at current upstream main; upstream retains uniform retry jitter rather than the fork exponential policy.
acceptance: Lock contention rolls back before retry.
Delay uses a 20ms base, jitter, exponential growth, and a 2s cap.
Retry exhaustion and non-lock failures remain explicit.
feature_lines.landing_state: SQLite writes remain correct for all callers; observability may be absent and does not gate retry behavior.
evidence_gaps: Revalidate deadline/attempt semantics against current upstream writer.
feature_lines.rationale: The policy is reusable substrate with an independent timing/rollback contract, not incidental logging.

feature_lines.name: Browser timeout cleanup
feature_lines.purpose: Make timeout cleanup configuration-gated, crash-resilient, and state-safe.
feature_lines.upstream_seam: tools/browser_tool.py daemon timeout cleanup at current upstream main.
acceptance: Timeout clears in-memory state through the finally path.
Daemon termination is opt-in and cleanup failures are contained.
feature_lines.landing_state: Browser timeout behavior is independently valid without any session search/runtime observability line.
evidence_gaps: Check whether current upstream orphan reaping supersedes the toggle.
feature_lines.rationale: No shared acceptance seam or runtime dependency exists with the other Phase-1 capabilities.

feature_lines.name: Configurable reasoning display
feature_lines.purpose: Expose a safe configurable reasoning display limit while preserving fence escaping.
feature_lines.upstream_seam: cli.py/config parsing and gateway display at current upstream main.
acceptance: Configured line limit controls display truncation.
Invalid/absent config falls back safely and escaping remains applied.
feature_lines.landing_state: Display behavior is independently valid without request transformation or telemetry.
evidence_gaps: Confirm current upstream config ordering and display hook.
feature_lines.rationale: A stable user-facing display contract exists without a dependency on adjacent request behavior.

feature_lines.name: Request transformation hook
feature_lines.purpose: Preserve the fork's explicit request transformation seam and its safe ordering contract.
feature_lines.upstream_seam: Current upstream request/model-call assembly hook; targeted seam comparison required before implementation.
acceptance: Transformation runs at the documented request boundary.
Disabled/missing hook leaves the original request unchanged and failures are explicit.
feature_lines.landing_state: Request assembly remains valid without configurable reasoning display.
evidence_gaps: Pin exact current upstream hook ordering and provider coverage.
feature_lines.rationale: Shared vicinity in request/display code is not a semantic dependency.
